prompts.animalReach: Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite animation sheet of THREE EXISTING CHARACTERS for a 2D VTT. References are exact dwarf cleric (row1), blonde elf (row2), short dark-curly-haired halfling (row3). Preserve identical faces, hair, clothes, beard, proportions and palettes. Stow weapons, free hands. EXACT SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, 18 uniform cells, landscape canvas, full body, all boots planted at the SAME baseline and x coordinates throughout each row. Character has constant body scale across their row. Transparent RGBA, NO horse, objects, ground, shadows, text, grid or halos. Each row is six poses for interacting with the muzzle of a FULL-SIZED HORSE that is not drawn. Pose0: standing neutral, both hands lowered (this is important for measuring original body height). Pose1: look up to right and start offering palm. Poses2,3,4: three incremental smooth gentle STROKING poses, fingers open and hand actually reachable at the required height, feet stay planted. Pose5: surprised by a gentle nose nudge, shoulders recoil and free arm balances, boots still planted. CRITICAL HAND HEIGHTS: dwarf row1 extends right arm UPWARD, palm ABOVE HIS HEAD, about 115 percent of head height from ground; blonde elf row2 extends hand forward at EYE/FACE height, about 88 percent of head height; halfling row3 fully extends right arm UPWARD with hand HIGH ABOVE HER HEAD, about 125 percent of head height. The short characters must visibly reach UP to the horse, not forward at waist level. Natural full anatomical arm extension, no elongated limbs, original bodies not stretched. Wrist and fingers make three small stroking motions in poses2-4 without changing planted legs. Natural attentive faces, crisp painted pixel sprites consistent with references, warm top-left highlights cool shadows, generous transparent padding so raised hands fit entirely.
